_note: The turntable and the field world (Game Design's docs/world/ring-any-angle/game-design.md sections 2, 10, 11; docs/architecture/field-ground.md; sim/core/field.gd, sim/core/swing.gd). Read only by a match on setup.planetGen 3: with any other generation nothing here is read. Every number is a first value.

causes._note: Peak in degrees a second; in and out in ticks: the rate rises over in, holds, falls over out. Game Design's rates, Camera's ramps (camera.md section 5). A launch's 20 keeps the whip clean; 10 out is ruled.

small._note: 2 to 15 degrees. peak is the size ceiling's rate: peak x min(1, sqrt(smallSize / degrees)). floorTicks is the least that eases at all. The shapes are each curve's peak over its mean, so the peak is what the rate law allows.

_keySample: seeded canonical nodes in the match key (sim/core/field.gd keyHash)
_farStride: columns: a far read (a forecast, a plan) takes every this many and interpolates. A multiple of the arena's columns' stride, 8
_ceilCols: columns: the stretch SimField.groundCeilAt bounds. A multiple of farStride
_standingLimit: units a second a standing body's ground may sweep (Game Design section 2)
_airborneLimit: units a second for a body in the air (Orb's word, 2026-10-31)
_limitOff: Orb's retry: the sweep limits and the rise backstop off; the rate is only the flash governor and the size ceiling
_flashRate: degrees a second: the flash governor, the most any swing runs at today (Game Design section 10)
_motion: a match's motion unless its setup names one (setup.swing): full, slow (every peak capped at slowRate), or off (no swing runs). Accessibility's swing-motion.md rule 2
_slowRate: degrees a second: slow's cap (Game Design section 9's 30, swingReduced)
_poseReach: units by planet distance from the pivot within which a swing tick moves a building's pose (Performance's bench; the EP's ruling). Everything is posed again at rest and at a launch plan's start. Past the list, in a swing, only the crowd's shelter and evacuation read a pose, and they count people, not places
_poseBody: the same from each of the pair: a sent body flies far from the pivot, and its contacts read the buildings it meets
_poseShot: the same from a shot in flight
_posePlan: units from the fighter a plan looks from, within which a plan's pose pass moves a building (the launch plan's candidates reach 10,400)
_layPerTick: columns a tick of the strip's cracks and scorch laid from the store after a rest, outward from the pair: what's in view (about 700 columns) in 7 ticks, the whole ring in 48
_poseStep: the list is laid again when the pivot crosses this many units
_poseEvery: and every this many swing ticks, since a far body's point moves with the turn
_riseMax: the most a standing fighter's ground rises a tick under a swing (the rate slows; rulings-2026-10-30 row 9)
_smallSize: degrees: the size ceiling is small.peak up to here, then falls as the root of the size (Game Design section 10)
